days.route_summary: Stay within Higashiyama; nearby stops are grouped to avoid backtracking.

slots.title: Morning Sightseeing
slots.description: Start early at Kiyomizu-dera, then follow the preserved Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka lanes.

slots.title: Lunch Recommendation
slots.description: Choose a seasonal tofu or soba set in a quiet Higashiyama restaurant.

slots.title: Afternoon Leisure
slots.description: Unwind in Maruyama Park and explore the craft shops around Gion.

slots.title: Evening Dining & Entertainment
slots.description: Reserve a small Kyoto kaiseki or izakaya table near Pontocho.

slots.title: Morning Sightseeing
slots.description: Walk the bamboo grove early and continue to Tenryu-ji temple gardens.

slots.title: Lunch Recommendation
slots.description: Enjoy yudofu or a vegetarian-friendly set meal near the river.

slots.title: Afternoon Leisure
slots.description: Cross Togetsukyo Bridge and take a slow riverside walk through Saga.

slots.title: Evening Dining & Entertainment
slots.description: Return to Gion for tea, lantern-lit lanes, and a compact dinner.
